# Listings in Quarto

A Quarto Listing creates an index of related pages. It is useful for a portfolio because each project can be stored in its own file while Quarto automatically organizes the collection.

## Why use a Listing?

Listings help visitors:

- Scan several projects quickly
- Filter projects by category
- Read a short description before opening a page
- Find the most recent work first

## Listing configuration

The listing on this page is created with the following YAML:

```yaml
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, date, categories]
  sort: "date desc"
  filter-ui: [categories]
```

The `contents` option tells Quarto to read pages from the `projects/` folder. The other options control the layout, displayed metadata, sorting, and filtering.

## Project metadata

Each project page can contain front matter like this:

```yaml
---
title: "Avenue Shabu: Growth in Repeat Guests"
description: "A CRM and customer analytics project about profitable repeat visits."
date: 2026-10-23
categories: [CRM, retention, customer analytics]
---
```

Adding another project only requires adding another QMD file to the `projects/` folder.
